Package com.example.impact.utils.role

Class OrganizerDb

java.lang.Object
com.example.impact.utils.role.OrganizerDb
public final class OrganizerDb extends Object
Centralizes all organizer-facing Firestore interactions.

Every helper in this class targets events/{eventId} subtrees by either mutating the event document itself or interacting with nested collections such as images/, waitingList/, or chosen/. Using these helpers keeps path construction out of controllers and fragments.

    • selectRandomEntrants

      public static com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<WaitingListEntry>> selectRandomEntrants(@NonNull String eventId, int count)
      Shuffles the waiting-list entries for an event and returns up to count of them. This helper is useful when organizers need to select random winners locally.
      Parameters:
      eventId - parent event identifier
      count - number of entrants to select (bounded by list size)
      Returns:
      task with the randomly selected entries

    • listenToWaitingList

      public static com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenToWaitingList(@NonNull String eventId, @NonNull com.google.firebase.firestore.EventListener<com.google.firebase.firestore.QuerySnapshot> listener)
      Subscribes to realtime waiting list changes for an event. Documents are returned in descending timestamp order so most recent actions appear first in the UI.

      listener - callback invoked with snapshot updates
      Returns:
      handle that can be removed to stop listening
